mentions.name: Swell Slots
mentions.description: A surf forecast web app with a 90's arcade art style inspired by Street Fighter 2. It lets surfers see at a glance which time slots of the week are good enough to go surfing, designed to look unlike any other surf forecast service.
mentions.problem: The author wanted a surf forecast app that could be read at a glance to find which time-slot of the week is good enough to go surf, and felt existing surf forecast options all looked the same.
mentions.source_excerpt:
a 90's Art Style (think Street Fighter 2) - Surf Forecast App.

I wanted a surf forecast app that i can look at glance, which "time-slot" of the week is good enough to go surf.

And I wanted it to look like nothing else out there, at least surf forecast wise

https://swellslots.com
